title: Gnome World’s Planning, Rivers and Folk, in Hazel
blurb: Three more Hazel modules in Gnome world, each off by default and held by the save check to give the same answers as the page's JavaScript: the speed run's planning, the rivers, pumps and rain, and the villagers, squirrels, insects and hawks, with the page's own random numbers worked out in Hazel. Each piece takes from about as long to 26 times as long in Hazel, and is small: with one on, the speed run takes about what it did (20.0 s); with every Hazel option on, the water among them, it does not finish in two minutes. Hazel is now 14% of the game's code; the drawing, 44% of app.js, is next.
